summary: DB-backed Beads output disagrees with JSONL-backed output for the same id.
transcript: At <repo>, `br show <issue>` reported status=open while `br show <issue> --no-db` read .beads/issues.jsonl and reported status=closed. `.beads/.write.lock` was present earlier, so raw BV ready output must not be treated as claimable until tracker snapshots are reconciled.
expected_agent_action: Do not claim the raw recommendation; compare DB and JSONL snapshots and request or perform a safe tracker refresh before changing issue status.
